Name: Avoid Losing Scepter
Author: atravita
Description:
[size=6]THIS IS A LEGACY MOD, for STARDEW 1.5.6 ONLY. STARDEW 1.6 HAS FIXED THE ISSUE. THANKS![/size]


This mod prevents you from losing the return scepter on death. Also prevents loss of the horse flute or the golden scythe

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12932]AtraCore[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Uninstall[/size]
Simply remove this mod from your Mods folder.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. Should be fine if installed for one player only in multiplayer.
[*]Should be compatible with most other mods. (Special handling for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10612]Moon Misadventures[/url], which has its own way of preventing you from losing certain things on death.)
[/list]

For other mod authors: if you would like this mod to forbid the loss of an item, just attach the context tag [code]prevent_loss_on_death
[/code] on that item.

[b][size=5]See also[/size][/b]

[list]
[*] [url=https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/AvoidLosingScepter/AvoidLosingScepter/docs/Changelog.md]Changelog[/url]
[*] [url=https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/AvoidLosingScepter/AvoidLosingScepter]Source code[/url]
[/list]
Requires SMAPI, uses Harmony.
